lead_raw_text:
The structure of K2Zr2N2 (KZN) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies N-centered octahedra with four K and two Zr neighbors, while K centers have nine geometric neighbors (five N, four Zr) and Zr centers have four N neighbors. The N-centered octahedra show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
